# KM-120 — Web cut: plain send, remove dead client features

**Lane:** app · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-102 · **Serializes with:** none (KM-130, KM-134, KM-135 and KM-172 depend on this ticket, so they already follow it)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/main.tsx`, `apps/web/src/main.css` (imports only), `apps/web/src/composition/**`, `apps/web/package.json` (`exports` only), the deleted `apps/web/src/features/*` directories listed below, `apps/web/src/features/join/JoinScreen.tsx` (one sentence), and, only if needed, the one `agent-presence` import plus the cases using it in `apps/connector/src/composition/agent/native-surface.test.ts` (Round 2 R9; see Risks).

## Outcome

The browser sends a message with one `client.sendEvent` call and no control-plane request. Review, owner listening controls, the channel-access inbox, owner-device trust and proof, closure, revocation, owner cleanup and agent rename / name-snapshot publishing are deleted from `apps/web`. A channel page renders exactly: header with title and roster, the share panel, the timeline and the composer.

## Context and evidence

- Plan U5 and KTD8 ("Human send is a plain `client.sendEvent`"); R13 (delete, don't hide).
- Send fence: `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts:414-450` (5-second rotation poll) and `:496-553` (fenced `sendEvent`), fed by `apps/web/src/main.tsx:66` (`sendFence: api.roomSend`).
- `room.tsx` is built around review: `apps/web/src/composition/human/room.tsx:82-90` (`createHumanRoomRenderer` takes review client, capability, trust callback), `:258-311` (owner-binding trust poll), `:418-428` (`toolsOnly` review page), `:442-476` (owner controls, rename, closure actions).
- Name snapshots: `matrix-browser.ts:653-685` (`publishNameSnapshots`) and `:705-733,741` (membership bootstrap that calls it). It paginates the whole history and throws `name_history_unavailable` on any undecryptable event, then retries every 5 s (`:713-717`). After KM-130 every link-joined human has undecryptable pre-join history, so this would loop forever, and with the fence gone each success posts `m.notice` rows that agents would ingest. Agent renaming is not an M1 feature (C3 labels come from the owner map), so it goes.
- `apps/web/src/internal/` still imports `features/channel-access`, `features/agent-controls` and `features/approval-decision` (`apps/web/src/internal/main.tsx:9,27-28`, `internal/controls/ListeningControl.tsx:3-4`, `internal/channel-requests/*`). KM-102 deletes `apps/web/src/internal/`; this ticket depends on it.
- Agent status polling: `apps/web/src/composition/human/agent-presence.ts:115-116` (`createChannelUiPort`, default endpoint `'/api/agent/status'`, polled every 5 s, `:117`) calls a control route KM-123 deletes. Deleting `agent-presence.ts` (Files below) removes the only `/api/agent/status` call in `apps/web` (`git grep -n "api/agent/status" -- apps/web` at `5db209cc` prints only `:116`).

## Scope

1. Plain send in `matrix-browser.ts`; remove the fence and every owner-trust port.
2. Remove review, controls, recovery (closure + revocation), channel-access, cleanup consumer and capabilities wiring from `main.tsx`, `mount.tsx`, `routes.ts`, `application.ts`, `browser-api.ts`.
3. Reduce `room.tsx` to roster + share + timeline + composer.
4. Delete the dead directories/files and their tests, harnesses and CSS imports.

## Non-goals

- Shared history visibility, cross-signing, pre-join filtering → **KM-130**.
- Agent confirmation route and `invite` port → **KM-134**.
- Agent attribution labels, participants response decoding → **KM-135** (leave `participants.resolve` in `browser-api.ts:345-372` unchanged).
- Control routes (`/api/human/room-send`, closure, revocation, channel-access) → **KM-123**. The web simply stops calling them.
- `apps/web/src/internal/`, `vite.internal.config.mjs`, `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs` → **KM-102**. `tests/integration/recovery/` (imports `composition/review`) → **KM-124**.
- Any visual change in `apps/web/src/ui/conversation/*` → design lane (**KM-180..186**). Do not touch those files.

## Contract and invariants

No C-section shape is produced or consumed. Invariants:
- KTD8: "The room-send fence, owner-device trust, review, owner mailbox, channel-access, revocation and closure clients are deleted from the web. The web never blacklisted unverified devices, and the new agent must not either." Do not add any device-verification check to send.
- User-facing copy says "channel", never "room"/"chat" (`pnpm check:terminology`).

### Worked example

Send, before: `ready` POST → `forceDiscardSession` → `acquire` POST → `client.sendEvent` → `finish` POST (4 control requests). After:

```ts
// input
{ roomId: '!abc:khala.local', clientTxnId: 'txn_1', content: { v: 1, kind: 'text', body: 'hello' } }
// exactly one call
client.sendEvent('!abc:khala.local', 'm.room.message', { msgtype: 'm.text', body: 'hello' }, 'txn_1')
// result
{ kind: 'done', value: { eventId: '$evt1', authorDeviceId: 'KH_WEB_…' } }
```

   room missing or `!hasEncryptionStateEvent()` → `{ kind: 'unavailable' }`; build payload exactly as `:532-536`; `await client.sendEvent(roomId, EventType.RoomMessage, payload, clientTxnId)`; return `done` with `response.event_id` and `client.getDeviceId()`; catch → `effectFailure(error)`. `MatrixSubstrate.sendEvent` becomes `return sendRoomMessage(this.active().client, input)` inside the existing try/catch.

## Test scenarios

`apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.test.ts`
1. Plain send: fake client with encrypted room; `sendRoomMessage` → `sendEvent` called once with `('!r', 'm.room.message', { msgtype: 'm.text', body: 'hello' }, 'txn_1')`; result `done`; a spied `globalThis.fetch` is never called (no `/api/human/room-send`).
2. Room not encrypted → `{ kind: 'unavailable' }`, `sendEvent` not called.
3. `sendEvent` rejects with `{ errcode: 'M_FORBIDDEN' }` → `{ kind: 'rejected', code: 'forbidden' }`; with a plain `Error` → `{ kind: 'unknown' }`.

`apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.test.ts`
4. `Object.keys(createHumanBrowserApi(...)).sort()` equals `['admission','channelLinks','credentials','identity','participants']`.

`apps/web/src/composition/human/routes.test.ts`
5. `parse('/channels/room_1/tools')` and `parse('/channel-requests')` → `kind: 'not_found'`; `parse('/channels/room_1')` → `channel`.

`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.test.tsx`
6. Ready channel route renders the injected `renderRoom` output; no "Channel requests" link exists in the owner sidebar.
7. Signed-out join path shows "Humans: sign in to accept this invitation." and not "Agent requests still wait for your approval".

`apps/web/src/composition/human/room.test.tsx` (new)
8. Render `renderHumanRoom` (via `renderToStaticMarkup`) with a fake ready context (conversations list containing the room, `participant()` returning a human, `admission` present): markup contains the composer label "Message", the share control, and none of "Recipient review", "Agent controls", "Close channel", "Review".

Integration (runs where the KM-101 stack exists): `tests/integration/human/create-share-chat.spec.ts` passes unmodified except where KM-130 changes it.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if `apps/web/src/internal/` still exists on `main` (KM-102 not merged): typecheck will fail on its imports of deleted features. Do not edit `internal/`.
- `apps/connector/src/composition/agent/native-surface.test.ts:24` imports `createChannelUiPort` from `apps/web/src/composition/human/agent-presence` by relative path. `apps/connector` is deleted by KM-124, which runs after this ticket. **Approved by the Executor (Round 2 R9):** if deleting `agent-presence.ts` breaks `pnpm typecheck` or a test run for `apps/connector`, delete only that one import and the test cases that use it in `native-surface.test.ts` (a test-only file KM-124 deletes anyway), and note it in the PR body as "R9: dropped the connector test import". If more is needed, stop and ask.
- Earlier drafts listed KM-130, KM-134, KM-135 and KM-172 as `serializes_with`; roster v2 does not, because they all depend on this ticket.
- **Stop** if `pnpm lint` fails inside `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs` because of a deleted path it names; report to the Executor (KM-102/KM-124 own that file).
- If a kept module unexpectedly imports a deleted one (for example `features/timeline` importing `features/review`), remove only the import and dead branch; if more than ~20 lines must change, stop and ask.
- `tests/integration/recovery/installed-hosted-recovery.test.mjs` imports `composition/review`; it is not in `pnpm test` and is deleted by KM-124. Leave it.

## Complexity rationale

3: wide but mechanical deletion across ~10 kept files and ~13 deleted directories; one small behavioral change (send) with a tight unit test. The risk is ordering (KM-102) and merge conflicts on shared composition files, not logic.
